reference_basis.name: GRCh38.p14
reference_basis.usage: Primary-contig names and lengths only; no reference bases are copied.

generator.name: sha256-counter-2bit-v1
generator.input: domain UTF-8 || 32-byte sample seed || contig UTF-8 || 00 || haplotype u8 || block index u64 big-endian
generator.position_rule: For one-based position p, block index=(p-1)//128 and base offset=(p-1)%128; consume each SHA-256 byte from its most-significant to least-significant two-bit pair.

notice: This deterministic sequence is wholly synthetic, is not a clinically realistic human genome, and must never be used for diagnosis or research conclusions. Two haplotypes are defined for every contig to avoid assigning sex or gender to demo identities.
